causal_hypothesis: A sustained decline in the nominal three-month U.S. Treasury yield may identify easing short-end funding conditions and lower cash opportunity cost before the next weekly BTC holding interval.
economic_hypothesis: A weekly full-capital BTC long-or-zero-yield-cash policy may retain sufficient BTC upside while avoiding tightening short-rate states to improve fee- and slippage-adjusted drawdown and Calmar versus matched buy-and-hold across Design, Validation and annual folds.

independence_boundary.not_closed_term_spread: The closed Treasury term-spread family compared ten-year yields with three-month, one-year and two-year yields. This family uses no long maturity and measures only the time change in the three-month policy-sensitive yield.
independence_boundary.not_closed_real_yield: The source-rejected real-yield family proposed a weekly change in ten-year inflation-protected real yield as DRA admission. This family uses an already sealed nominal three-month Treasury source and a standalone BTC long/cash policy.
independence_boundary.not_fed_balance_sheet_or_dollar: The feature contains no WALCL level, dollar index, NFCI, EPU, equity, BTC price, volatility or on-chain input.
independence_boundary.not_cash_carry: Cash remains zero yield under matched accounting; the three-month yield is solely a lagged external state and is not credited as portfolio income.

adversarial_prior: Short-rate declines may occur only after recession or crisis risk is already visible and therefore can lag BTC drawdowns.
Long periods of nearly unchanged low rates may produce sparse transitions and excessive cash or BTC exposure.
Present-vintage Treasury observations do not establish original historical publication values despite the next-day lag.
The 42-observation and 84-observation variants are rejection-only stability checks and cannot replace a failed 63-observation primary.
stop_conditions: Stop before economics if corpus identity, Treasury row ordering, next-day availability, lookback indexing or H1 continuity fails.

Stop NO_CANDIDATE if the 63-observation primary or either rejection-only neighbor fails any Design, Validation, annual breadth, cost, drawdown, Calmar, upside, concentration, holding or terminal-inventory gate.
Do not scan another maturity, yield level, threshold, lookback, smoothing rule, evaluation day, lag, holding interval, cash yield, sizing rule, leverage or short leg after outcome access.
Do not combine this state with the closed term-spread, real-yield, Fed, dollar, NFCI, EPU, equity, BTC trend or DRA family as a rescue.
missing_proof: No deterministic three-month-yield easing ledger, economic runner or frozen manifest exists.
No matched-capital Design, Validation, stress, annual breadth or path-risk result exists.
No independent OOS or forward evidence exists.
scope_note: Pre-outcome source-reuse prior only. No short-rate strategy outcome, runner, manifest, candidate, OOS, paid API, second timer, second writer, external backfill, canonical write, Production, Trading, database, order, fund, OCO, Grid, SHADOW, PAPER or LIVE action occurred.
